answer: Because the plume calculation reruns each epoch, the ivory weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the mirror settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 122 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 58% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
